status: design fixed before R24 execution; not an external preregistration

interior_diagnostic.coefficient_grid: independent integer coordinates in [-7,7], divided by 8
comparators: common outer time-only at the same interior objective
interior_diagnostic.certificate: exact rational feasible lower and Fenchel upper bounds for both comparators
interior_diagnostic.reported_slack: vertex-mixture upper minus true comparator, separated into outer-set and interpolation components
interior_diagnostic.scope: descriptive diagnostic on a designed uncertainty family, not coverage calibration or a field failure rate

matched_timing.labels: independently audited full accepted optima and optimizer resource vectors; full generation cost charged
matched_timing.fallback: same fresh lifted full-objective workspace at numerical tolerance 1e-9, including setup and rational audit; no claimed transfer of predictor state into fallback
matched_timing.memory: serialized predictor bytes, owned predictor array bytes, solver sparse matrix bytes, and process peak RSS with scope stated
matched_timing.statistics: context-clustered paired bootstrap intervals after averaging repetitions; conditional on each fixed fit, descriptive, no retraining-level inference
matched_timing.amortization: label generation plus method-specific fit and incremental setup versus lifted continuation; finite observed crossing only when mean online savings is positive; uncertainty interval separately reported

retrospective_analysis.r22_scaling: all 800 rows, medians, IQR, paired differences; original eight-context limitation retained
retrospective_analysis.r23_robust_cost: all 1152 implementations, own time plus all eight shared comparator solves charged once per independently certified decision; prediction is separately identified because absent from original timer

retention: Keep every failure, fallback, nonpositive certificate, adverse comparison, original theorem and original experiment; no field calibration or neural superiority is assumed.
